reviews.title: Motive not currently working properly
reviews.text:
I notified my company that the app wasn’t working correctly a couple weeks ago. I sent in screenshots of the problem. It does not log off driving once the vehicle stops.
That was weeks ago with no response. Yesterday it ran me over on drivetime because it didn’t shut down from driving mode. Now, they say they know they have a problem. If they know they have a problem they should be telling the thousands of drivers out there that are using their app and getting charged for drivetime they’re not using by their app. But they haven’t yet. This is not a good company. good companies are transparent and let people know when there is a problem with their software. Before they run into trouble.

reviews.title: Eating away at my hours, one stop at a time.
reviews.text:
What’s new on the update? Every time i stop, the drive time minutes keep counting down. Before, say I stopped driving to take a quick break, the drive window would remain for a few minutes, usually 5. Back then, I’d just change modes to on or off duty, and my logs would reflect that I’ve been stationary for X amount of time. Now, say I’m stationary for 4 minutes and then select my mode (on, off duty or sleeper) my stationary minutes won’t reflect on my logs. This new update steals minutes from me at every stop. 

This should be illegal, because in my eyes it’s a false record of duty status. How is it fine with you guys to let my drive time hours be consumed by 6 minutes during every stop I take if I don’t rush to change my mode asap?

reviews.title: They changed their complience rules
reviews.text: I used to park, go to the restroom and while coming back. Switch to off duty and the eld would count from when i park as off duty. Not anymore, if i park and go use the restroom the. 5 mins later i click off duty, it will say off duty from the time i change status and count the 5 mins before i did as driving even tho i was parked and in the bathroom. It does this 7 times a day, i lose 3.5h of my time a week. Cancellingy renewal

Some Company probably purchased the App and pulled it to cut the market clean of Usable, Inexpensive Competition for guys who didn’t run in fleets. Really a shame.

reviews.title: Constant Connection Issues
reviews.text:
I can’t believe this is even allowed by DOT. It’s horrible and is constantly having issues connecting. Seems like a test run in a BETA version.

Go into an office or truck stop, it may or may not reconnect. When it does the little reset button doesn’t do anything. Gotta unplug wait until the damn battery dies and try again. 

I miss our old Omnitracs. They were far more reliable and stable. I haven’t used customer support as I don’t have time in my run to deal with that. And who wants to waste their off time troubleshooting a junky gadget.

I can’t believe a large company like FedEx would mandate this POS.

It’s basically another data collection tool that watches you all day and the creeps in charge of monitoring it watch you for the own weird pleasure. Then decide if and when to mess with your employment. It’s a gross joke

reviews.title: Completely inadequate for teams, not ready for release
reviews.text:
So this was forced on us in a company switch.
EVERY other ELD ties load and trip information to the TRUCK, so that when one driver changes trailers, the ELD includes them on the other driver's log. But NOT this bunch. Every time my wife takes over, I have to type out the (up to 9, since we're talking about pulling doubles and I do some shuttle work as she sleeps) trailer and load info, and text it to her so she can type in what EVERY OTHER ELD does in the background. So handy in addition to morning ablution and grabbing a breakfast to spend 10 minutes in stupid work.
Oh, and it wants to carry ALL of yesterday's trailers or none of them. Wouldn't JUST THE LAST SET be a good option, since we've dropped the others?
Oh, and yesterday, she went to 16 minutes left, and this crapp (notice the portmanteau) never made a goddamn sound. Every other ELD I've experienced gives a warning at 59, 29, and 19. But this app is kind enough not to distract you while you're busy driving. I'm not sure it would have done a doggone thing had she continued another 17 minutes.
Just. Ick. Lousy experience.
FLEETS, DON'T INFLICT THIS ON YOUR TEAMS
PS: whilst in yard move, if you spend less than 5 minutes hooking up, it won't let you enter new trailer numbers or load information.
Clearly drafted by people who have never seen the inside of a truck.

reviews.title: Motive is horrible
reviews.text:
-I wish you could give them  negative stars …honestly the worst professional business experience I’ve ever had in my life. I have no clue how they sponsor golfers on PGA Tour. Actually, they do it because they just take people’s money like me.

I’ve called 50 times I’ve emailed more. Someone with a broken American accent calls me back and tells me that they have pushed my case up.

I have five truck and trailers that require ELD’s.. they sent me 10 units to keep in my office for future hires. They promised and explained that I would only be charged when the units were installed .. We’re going on two months now they’re trying to charge me over $2000 each month. I’ve called my bank and put a cancel on it and have been trying to get someone from motive to call me back for two months now….

I would recommend if you’re getting in the truck in Business to not call this company. They are foreigners who lie and they will not answer the phone…. Literally the whole company won’t answer the phone.

I now have thousand dollars invested in this company and I have five drivers running paper logs because motive doesn’t have the decency to call one of their clients back. I am filing BBB reviews, and going to destroy them on every platform known to man.

reviews.title: Doesn’t automatically change timezones in real time.
reviews.text:
I got my first solo HOS violation because of this app not automatically changing timezones. You know how almost any Phone (Especially my iPhone) will automatically change timezones when you travel, Motive doesn’t do that. And I was trying to fix my logs but almost all of my drive time winded up being in violation. If only there was an option to undo log edits now that this has happened to me. I’m blessed that I don’t have legal problems because of this.

Motive, I’ve spoken to you before, PLEASE FOR THE LOVE OF GOD FIND A WAY TO AUTOMATICALLY CHANGE TIMEZONES BASED ON GPS LOCATION - I EVEN HAVE A MOTIVE DASHCAM!

reviews.title: Is this some sort of practical joke?
reviews.text: Worst app ever!!!😡 I VOLUNTEER (i.e. don’t get paid) to drive a trailer for a non profit once every three months or so. Are you seriously telling me that I need to track all of my other non driving related work activity on this stupid app?!?! Ooo, I started working (not in a vehicle mind you) at 7:52, then I took a lunch break at 12:12, then I resumed working at 12:57, then I stopped working at 4:53. What on earth does that have to do with me driving a trailer 2 months from now? 😡😡😡😡😡 What possible psychological issue do you have that makes you feel like you require a status update from me every 4 hours? You NEED TO FIX THIS!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! What kind of dictatorial setup are you going for?🤔At the very least there should be a way to auto input the fact that I’m not going to be using my Non-CDL for the next 2 months so I don’t need to update the app. You are causing 10’s of thousands of people to manually update this app while driving on their way to and from work, because they forgot before. Well done genius👌

Distraction for looking down for 2 secs to put a drink in the cup holder. I could go on about the false alerts this system gives you. Bottom line is if you’re thinking of getting this for your company, don’t. There’s plenty of way more functional options out there.
